name: Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff
core_rationale: Ninth warm terracotta spice-drying bluff of Continent 01 where Sola's aromatic hearth-drafts cure cinnamon-bark windbreaks above the eastern orchard rim.
local_conflict: Cinnamon-bark beetles and playful ember-tail foxes nest inside the warm spice-drying flues.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Swirling aromatic spice-drafts across Star-Anise Promontory require Mill-Steward Clove's Star-Pod Lantern.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Bakers in Saffron-Press Village say the warm breezes from Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff smell of toasted cinnamon-sugar before every sunrise.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Terraced terracotta spice-towers with curling cinnamon-bark louvers along the eastern basin rim.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What star-anise wind-belfry crowns Star-Anise Promontory?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the eastern spice-drying bluffs of Continent 01 and connects west to Saffron-Press Village.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Terraced terracotta spice-towers with curling cinnamon-bark louvers venting warm aromatic drafts.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m spice-viaduct roads, 0.58m spice-mill counters, and 0.14m terracotta risers tailored to 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix at [0,1], [1,1], [1,1] floor -1, and [1,0] with flora_fauna and carapace monster families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-star-anise-promontory in Mystery status behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_reason.
